findings.title: CronJob's runs fail, and their Jobs are deleted at once
findings.cause: CronJob backup's runs fail: its last 5 runs failed (backup-29931184, backup-29931183, backup-29931182, backup-29931181, backup-29931180), and it has never completed a run. Its failedJobsHistoryLimit is 0, so the controller deletes each failed Job and its pods as soon as it sees it, and there is no pod or log left to say why

evidence.detail: Job has reached the specified backoff limit

evidence.what: CronJob backup keeps no failed Job (failedJobsHistoryLimit: 0)

findings.fix: Set failedJobsHistoryLimit to 1 or more so the next failed run's Job and pods stay to be read (kubectl logs job/<name>), or start a run by hand to watch it: kubectl create job --from=cronjob/backup backup-debug -n kd-cronjob-failures-deleted.
